CustomField.description: Market Value from loan domain determined by the collateral assessment policy
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This amount is determined using several independent property data vendors and applying algorithms and is used to assess this loan application. Factors including property location, property attributes and past market performance will determine the property value. If an automated valuation is unavailable in-app, ANZ Plus will do this manually. This amount may differ from the price the property might sell for.
